fichas.title: Housing suitable for wheelchair users
fichas.summary: Housing should allow wheelchair users to reach and use all rooms and shared facilities as independently as possible. The text specifies turning space, entrance and lobby sizes, a low-parapet window, and an entry phone for blind residents.
uses: Independent movement and access for wheelchair users
Providing a clear view through a living-room window
Supporting blind residents at the entrance

fichas.title: Living and open-air seating areas
fichas.summary: Living rooms should provide wheelchair movement space and room for at least two visiting wheelchair users. The page gives minimum living-area floor sizes by household size, a minimum room width for smaller households, and minimum dimensions for an outdoor seating area and its movement area.

fichas.title: Accessible dwelling layouts and entrance details
fichas.summary: The sheet illustrates entrance arrangements, dining layouts, accessible flat plans, an extension with a ramp, and installation of a vertical lift. Plan captions identify single-room and two-room flats and accessible flats in buildings with different numbers of flats per floor. Dimensions are included where explicitly legible in the supplied text or drawings.
